gap: No result ChatGPT got states, for each front-and-rear camera under $200, the maker's exact parking-mode kit with its price and the kits the maker excludes (VIOFO HK4 $17.99 for the A229 Plus; Vantrue Voltage Display kit $29.99 for the S1 Pro, whose 5-Level kit list omits it; DDPAI's $29.99 fuse-tap kit, as its $19.99 Type-C IPS kit is listed only for MINI5, Z40 and N3 Pro), nor that the A229 Plus's 6 m rear cable cannot be extended with an ordinary USB cable.
standout_why: I read knowledgelib (cited), DashCamTalk (cited), PCWorld (cited), productbible, milewitness, truepicked and roadgearlab; vortexradar and winchinsider returned 403 and thecargearguide a certificate error, so those three are unchecked. knowledgelib already names the HK4 for the A229 Plus 2CH and the UP05 for an A510 bundle, but gives no kit price. productbible names HK4 and HK6 for other VIOFO models without prices. milewitness names Vantrue's VP05 bundle for the S1 Pro without a price. truepicked gives only an unnamed '$15 hardwire kit' for the A229 Pro and says 70mai 4G 'uses T-Mobile network', where 70mai's own listing recommends AT&T. None gives a rear cable length (productbible only says 'check the length included'), a kit exclusion list, or which rear camera fits the A810S rather than the A810. So rivals hold part of the kit pairing; the prices, exclusions and cable limit are new.
decides: It confirms the pick rather than changing it, and answers ChatGPT's own caveat about whether $200 covers the hardwire kit. On the figures read 2026-11-21, each candidate stays under $200 with its maker's kit: A229 Plus 2CH $159.99 (ChatGPT's Best Buy figure, which I did not open) + HK4 $17.99 = $177.98; Vantrue S1 Pro 2CH $135.99 + Voltage Display kit $29.99 = $165.98; 70mai's A810S Road Trip Kit (front, rear, card, hardwire kit, CPL) is listed from $177.78; our DDPAI N5 Pro takes the $29.99 fuse-tap kit, not the $19.99 one. Two cautions for the page: VIOFO's own US store lists the A229 Plus 2CH at $229.99, over budget, so that row depends on a retailer price; and DDPAI's catalog feed showed the N5 Pro at $259.00 for an unidentified variant, so re-read our row's price before publishing. Long vehicles favour the A229 Plus only if the buyer adds VIOFO's own 8 m or 10 m cable, because the stock 6 m cable cannot be extended.

findings.label: Maker's hardwire kit, price and exclusions
findings.value: HK4 Type-C hardwire cable, $17.99 (list $25.99), 4 m (13.1 ft); for A119 Mini 2 / A229 Plus / A229 Pro / A229 Ultra / A329 / T130 / WM1; not compatible with mini-port A119 V3 / A129 Duo / A129 Pro Duo / A129 Plus Duo / A129 Plus Duo IR

findings.note: Read from viofo.com's own catalog search feed via storecheck search; product-page fetches returned HTTP 429. The feed gives one price per product, so the fuse-type variant behind $17.99 is not identified.

findings.label: Longer hardwire kit and fuse taps
findings.value: 6 m (19.68 ft) HK4, $19.99, 'Fuse Tap is not included'; VIOFO 2-piece fuse tap set $5.99

findings.note: Catalog search feed. The fuse tap price is from https://www.viofo.com/products/2pcs-circuit-fuse-tap-with-mini-micro2-micro3-ato-mini-low-profile-adapter-holder, same read. The 4 m HK4 listing text does not say whether a fuse tap is included.

findings.label: Which VIOFO kit not to buy for hybrid parking
findings.value: VIOFO says Hybrid Parking Mode 'requires the HK6 — the older HK4 does not support voltage-based switching', and describes the HK6 ($25.99) as the companion for the A329S, A329T and A329WW
findings.source_title: VIOFO Type-C HK6 ACC Hardwire Kit for A329S/A229/A119M Pro Series, Supports Hybrid Parking Mode
findings.note: Catalog search feed. The listing title names 'A229', but the body ties hybrid parking to the A329S series; the text I read does not say the A229 Plus gains hybrid parking with an HK6.

findings.label: Rear cable length and extension limit
findings.value: The 2CH kit ships with a 6 m Type-C to Type-C rear cable; 'This cable cannot be extended manually by connecting other USB cables'; VIOFO sells 1 m, 6 m, 8 m and 10 m lengths from $9.99; fits A229 Plus / Pro / Ultra, 'unsuitable for the old A229 Duo model'
findings.source_title: VIOFO Rear Cable/Interior Cable for A229 Plus/A229 Pro/A229 Ultra Car Dash Camera
findings.note: Catalog search feed. $9.99 is the feed's single price; the price of each length is not identified.

findings.value: 2-channel: front 2560×1440 + rear 2560×1440, Sony STARVIS 2 IMX675 on both, HDR on both. RE200 rear camera ($79.99, 6 m cable) turns an A229 Plus or Pro 1CH into 2CH with no firmware change; RWC200 IP67 exterior rear camera $89.99 fits the A229 Plus / Pro
findings.source_title: VIOFO A229 Plus 2CH Front and Rear 2K+2K HDR 5GHz Wi-Fi GPS Voice Control Dual Dash Camera with Sony STARVIS 2 Sensor

RE200 from https://www.viofo.com/products/viofo-re200-2k-rear-camera-with-6m-type-c-cable-and-sticker-for-a229-plus-a229-pro and RWC200 from https://www.viofo.com/products/viofo-rwc200-waterproof-rear-camera-for-a229-plusa229-pro, same read. Frame rate is not in the text I read.

findings.label: Maker's US store price
findings.value: $229.99, in stock, no sale price shown
findings.source_title: VIOFO A229 Plus 2CH Front and Rear 2K+2K HDR 5GHz Wi-Fi GPS Voice Control Dual Dash Camera with Sony STARVIS 2 Sensor

findings.label: Which rear camera fits (and which does not)
findings.value: RC24 in-car rear camera (F1.55, 130°, 1080p HDR) is listed for A810S / T800; RC23 exterior camera is listed for A800SE / A810S / T800, and the A810S page calls it 'not available yet'. The RC12 and RC11 (5.5 m cable) are listed for A510 / A810 and others, with the A810S absent
findings.source_title: 70mai Rear Camera for Dash Cam A810S/ T800
findings.note: 70mai.store catalog search feed. RC12 list from https://70mai.store/products/rc12-rear-cam; 'not available yet' from https://70mai.store/products/4k-a810s. 70mai says both A810S rear options use a Sony IMX662 at 1080p HDR 30 fps. PCWorld lists 'Non-standard rear camera cable' as a con of the A810.

findings.label: Hardwire kits and 4G region limits
findings.value: 70mai Type-C hardwire kit listing from $27.99: UP03 is the plain parking kit for USB Type-C cams; UP04 (4G) is 'only for Australia (Telstra 4G Carrier recommended) and Korea'; UP05 (4G) is 'only for the US (AT&T Carrier recommended)'; micro-USB cams need the UP02. Adjustable UP06 is $35.99
findings.source_title: 70mai Hardwire Kit with USB Type-C Port
findings.note: Catalog search feed; the variant behind $27.99 is not identified. The listing's model list reads 'for Dash Cam A510/ A810/ Omni/ 4K Omni/ 4K T800' and does not name the A810S. UP06 from https://70mai.store/products/up06. 70mai's AT&T recommendation conflicts with truepicked's 'uses T-Mobile network'.

findings.label: Store prices for camera and all-in kit
findings.value: A810S listing from $139.99 (list $229.99); '4K Road Trip Kit: 4K A810S Front Cam + Rear Cam + Memory Card + Hardwire Kit + CPL Filter' from $177.78 (list $327.97); both in stock
findings.source_title: 4K Road Trip Kit: 4K A810S Front Cam + Rear Cam + Memory Card + Hardwire Kit + CPL Filter
findings.note: Catalog search feed. A810S price from https://70mai.store/products/4k-a810s. The feed does not show whether $139.99 is the front-only or the front + RC24 variant, nor which card size the kit price covers. CPL2 filter for A810 / A810S is $13.99 at https://70mai.store/products/cpl2.

findings.label: Supported card size
findings.value: microSD 32 GB to 256 GB; 70mai's 512 GB card is listed only for the 4K Omni, T800 and A800SE

findings.label: Hardwire kits that name the S1 Pro, and one that does not
findings.value: Voltage Display Hardwire Kit $29.99 (list $34.99) and Voltage Display OBD Cable $29.99 both name the S1 Pro, with cut-off at 11.6 / 12 / 12.4 V. The 5-Level Adjustable Hardwire Kit ($34.99) lists N4S, N4 Pro S, N5 S, N5, N4 Pro, N4, E1, E2, E3, S2, N2S, X4S and says it does not work for other Vantrue cams; the S1 Pro is not on that list
findings.note: vantrue.com catalog search feed. OBD cable from https://www.vantrue.com/products/voltage-display-obd-cable; 5-Level kit from https://www.vantrue.com/products/5-level-adjustable-hardwire-kit. Vantrue also sells a Universal 11.5 ft ACC kit at $24.99 (fixed 11.6 V cut-off, 'only work for Vantrue dash cam') that does not name models: https://www.vantrue.com/products/universal-11-5ft-acc-hardwire-kit.

findings.label: Price, channels, card and LTE add-on (maker's figures)
findings.value: $135.99 (list $199.99), in stock; 2-channel: front 2.5K (1944p) + rear 1080p, front 158° and rear 165°, supercapacitor, GPS, 15 s pre-event buffer, 'up to 512GB SD cards', CPL optional. 4G LTE Module $149.99 fits the S1 Pro and needs the camera's firmware updated to the latest version for cloud features
findings.note: Catalog search feed. LTE module from https://www.vantrue.com/products/4g-lte-module-with-sim-card; its SIM carries 300 MB of initial data. milewitness reports the S1 Pro manual says 1 TB against 512 GB on the product page; I did not open the manual. The listing headline says Sony STARVIS 2 while a body line says 'SONY STARVIS sensors', so the per-camera sensor is not settled by this page.

findings.label: What the rival pages say on kits and cables
findings.value: knowledgelib: A229 Plus 2CH 'needs a microSD card and Viofo's HK4 hardwire kit, both sold separately', no kit price, no cable length. productbible: all seven of its picks 'need a hardwire kit for parking mode', no kit prices, 'check the length included before you buy'. milewitness: 'Vantrue sells a bundle with its VP05 hardwire kit', no price.
